Tier2 plain conversion with accessible names disabled

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"inline_data_media\":\"AltTextOnly\",\"output_format\":\"Plain\",\"tier_strategy\":\"Tier2\"}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convertWithAccessibleNames(html: "<p><svg aria-label=\"Name\"><text>Drawn</text></svg></p>", useAccessibleNames: false, options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
